title: MiniMax H3 Reference to Video LoRA
description: References into video with synchronized audio using MiniMax H3

pricing.text: Video costs $0.0625 per second at 480p, $0.075 per second at 768p, $0.1625 per second at 2K and $0.20 per second at 4K.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: Text prompt for video generation. Refer to reference assets by their modality and order in the reference lists: Image 1, Image 2, Video 1, Audio 1, and so on.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.tooltip: The duration of the video in seconds.

inputs.name: resolution
inputs.tooltip: The resolution of the generated video. 480P and 768P are native generation modes; 2K and 4K upscale a 768P base result.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.tooltip: Random seed. A random seed is selected when omitted. -1 leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: enable_safety_checker
inputs.tooltip: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled.

inputs.name: prompt_expansion_mode
inputs.tooltip: How much effort to spend rewriting the prompt before generation. 'disabled' skips prompt expansion. 'fast' returns in about a second. 'balanced' picks per request. 'quality' spends up to ~30s on a richer prompt. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: aspect_ratio
inputs.tooltip: The aspect ratio of the generated video.

inputs.name: reference_image
inputs.tooltip: URLs of subject/style reference images, referenced in the prompt as Image 1, Image 2, and so on. Reference images, videos, and audio clips must add up to at most 12 files. Each socket may carry a batch; they are sent in socket order (the first picture of socket 1 is number 1).

inputs.name: reference_video
inputs.tooltip: URLs of motion/reference video clips (2-15 seconds each, combined duration at most 15 seconds), referenced in the prompt as Video 1, Video 2, and so on. Reference images, videos, and audio clips must add up to at most 12 files. Each socket may carry a batch; they are sent in socket order (the first picture of socket 1 is number 1).

inputs.name: reference_audio
inputs.tooltip: URLs of reference audio clips (2-15 seconds each, combined duration at most 15 seconds), referenced in the prompt as Audio 1, Audio 2, and so on. Images, videos, and audio can be provided individually or together. Reference images, videos, and audio clips must add up to at most 12 files. Each socket may carry a batch; they are sent in socket order (the first picture of socket 1 is number 1).

inputs.name: loras
inputs.tooltip: List of LoRA adapters to apply to the transformer. JSON. Required.

omitted.why: yes/no sync_mode returns the file inline and drops it from fal's request history - always left off
